stages.name: Sowing
stages.task: Prepare seedbed, treat seeds, and sow at 5cm depth.

stages.name: CRI Stage
stages.task: Crown Root Initiation: First critical irrigation is mandatory.

stages.name: Tillering
stages.task: Apply nitrogenous fertilizer. Monitor for early aphid attacks.

stages.name: Heading/Flowering
stages.task: Irrigate if soil is dry. Monitor for rust diseases.

stages.name: Dough Stage
stages.task: Grain filling begins. Moderate moisture needed. Protect from birds.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.task: Harvest when grains are hard and moisture is around 12-14%.

stages.name: Nursery Sowing
stages.task: Sow seeds in well-prepared nursery beds. Maintain shallow water.

stages.name: Transplanting
stages.task: Transplant seedlings in puddled field. Keep 2-3cm standing water.

stages.name: Tillering
stages.task: Top dressing of Nitrogen. Maintain 5cm standing water.

stages.name: Panicle Initiation
stages.task: Critical moisture stage. Do not allow field to dry.

stages.name: Grain Filling
stages.task: Maintain shallow water, drain water 10-15 days before harvest.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.task: Harvest when 80% panicles turn golden yellow.

stages.name: Sowing
stages.task: Sow treated seeds in moist soil. Maintain proper spacing.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.task: Inter-culture operations for weed control. Apply first fertilizer dose.

stages.name: Square Formation
stages.task: Critical stage for moisture. Scout for early pests (Whitefly/Jassids).

stages.name: Flowering & Boll Development
stages.task: Highest water and nutrient requirement. Install pheromone traps for Bollworm.

stages.name: Boll Bursting
stages.task: Stop irrigation. Sunny and dry weather is ideal.

stages.name: Picking
stages.task: Manual picking of fully opened bolls in morning hours.

stages.name: Nursery
stages.task: Sow seeds in pro-trays/raised beds. Protect from damping off.

stages.name: Transplanting
stages.task: Transplant in main field at evening. Provide immediate light irrigation.

stages.name: Vegetative Growth
stages.task: Staking (for indeterminate types). Apply fertilizers and weed.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.task: Critical for irrigation to prevent blossom drop. Apply micronutrients.

stages.name: Fruiting
stages.task: Maintain even soil moisture to prevent fruit cracking and blossom end rot.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.task: Pick fruits at breaker/red stage depending on market distance.
